title: Real collision HP loss changes mounted and wild palettes; normal nurse healing clears follower tint

verification.actor: Current Wild Snorlax and Weepinbell, mounted party Cyndaquil, then the same healed party Cyndaquil as Follower.
verification.trigger: Allow ordinary Ambush collisions to produce two mounted HP losses and a Wild HP loss. Use checked normal nurse input to heal the same party member, then bind its current Follower.
verification.observable: Real party/resident HP and actual SDK palette bytes show the softer injury-dependent red pulse at the current Actor frame. Two real party hits remain required. Rising and falling strength at unchanged HP reuse one private palette; each exact MAT word5 uses the completed upload. Native stock healing restores full HP; the current Follower has no tint record/callback and uses its original palette.

setupMutations.change: Use private ROM/save copies and the same declared native placement and party setup as the existing collision test. HP/motion/timers/RNG remain natural after binding.

limits: Prepared native actor acquisition does not prove natural spawning or normal party selection.
Every receipt comes from the current completed queue and exact current full identity. No screenshots or video.
Full-HP clear is checked after genuine field teardown and normal nurse healing; it does not claim item healing in place.

events.value: Bind actual current actors and their real full HP.
Read actual palette upload bytes and material word after natural gameplay changes.
Observe native healing or natural expiry clear the tint.

stop.condition: Complete every exact native palette and clear fact; fail on missing identity, upload completion, material use, HP or full condition state.

invariants: Actual palette bytes and actual MAT command must agree on the same current Pokémon.
Missing or stale receipts fail; cache or configured values alone cannot pass.
